version_method: Read distribution METADATA/direct_url.json as text; Lab and PhysX are editable checkouts. Metadata does not prove runtime compatibility.

findings.claim: Existing task is single-environment CPU PhysX, dt 1/240 s, decimation 12.
findings.remaining_gate: Do not switch backend or modify the task for this audit.

findings.claim: Experimental FEM asset exposes nodal state, mesh counts and kinematic targets; volume/surface paths exist.
findings.remaining_gate: GPU deformable test and real knife contact unexecuted. No inspected high-level per-node external-force setter or fracture operation.

findings.claim: ModelBuilder.add_spring/add_soft_grid/add_soft_mesh and particle/body state/force paths are installed. Spring stiffness and damping are model arrays read by the simple solver each force evaluation.
findings.remaining_gate: Damage state, law, reset and zero-residual broken bonds are custom work. Updating arrays is a source-grounded proposal, not a demonstrated runtime result.

findings.claim: Particle-body contact kernel accumulates particle force and dynamic rigid-body force/moment. A rigid-soft example and Lab contrib builder bridge exist.
findings.remaining_gate: Test reaction signs, momentum balance, geometry resolution and prescribed-body reaction logging. No coupled run was performed.

findings.claim: Spring kernel computes 1/length without a zero-length guard; coincident duplicate interface nodes cannot be joined blindly by this spring.
findings.remaining_gate: Use finite rest-length bonds and verify compression/shear behaviour, or design a regularized cohesive element; do not implement yet.

findings.claim: Simple Newton solver documents no equality/mimic constraints and no enforcement of some effort/velocity options.
findings.remaining_gate: Unsuitable as a drop-in replacement for the coupled hand task. Separate mechanics feasibility from whole-robot integration.

findings.claim: No ready-made cohesive blade-damage or arbitrary-fracture operation identified in inspected Lab asset/sim interfaces and Newton sim/solver source. Generic breaks on rigid joints are not a deformable cutting model.
findings.remaining_gate: Custom interface damage and cut-face/contact handling required. This is not a claim about every installed binary or optional package.

findings.claim: PhysX JointWrenchSensor reads incoming link reaction and splits force/torque at the child-side joint anchor.
findings.remaining_gate: Physical sensor axes/model unknown; calibrate sign, frame, gravity, inertia and timing. Torque-only actor must mask simulated forces.
No deformable/cut-face rendering or localization test performed.

recommendation.model: reduced particle/spring solid with finite-length interface bonds across one prescribed plane
recommendation.prototype_backend: installed Newton primitives, mechanics-only separate experiment
recommendation.selection_status: source-grounded candidate; not validated or implemented
recommendation.fem_role: coarse fixed-interface FEM comparison after reduced-model mechanics and resource gates
recommendation.integration_gate: Before robot adoption, prove mimic/joint limits and two-way coupling with unchanged hand/grasp behaviour. No engine switch or external co-simulation is authorized.

search_scope: Lab core and PhysX deformable assets
Newton sim and solver Python source; selected examples
limits: Source presence is not executed validation.
No calibrated material, force limits or hardware sensor contract.
No runtime throughput or memory claim.
